name: @find-how/pioneer-brand-assets
description: Wrangler-deployable brand asset portal for Pioneer.

scripts.check: npm run build && node --check src/index.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/interactive-components.js
scripts.dev: PLUS_COMPONENTS_BUILD=true WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --var PLUS_COMPONENTS_ENABLED:true --var PLUS_COMPONENTS_DEV_BYPASS:true
scripts.deploy:plus: PLUS_COMPONENTS_BUILD=true WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --var PLUS_COMPONENTS_ENABLED:true
scripts.plus:dev: PLUS_COMPONENTS_BUILD=true WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --local --var PLUS_COMPONENTS_ENABLED:true --var PLUS_COMPONENTS_DEV_BYPASS:true
scripts.preview: PLUS_COMPONENTS_BUILD=true WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --local --var PLUS_COMPONENTS_ENABLED:true --var PLUS_COMPONENTS_DEV_BYPASS:true
